macro.text: 10-year Treasury yield slipped back near 5% as AI-worry selling drove safe-haven demand
Oil climbed to an Iran-war high on bets of fresh US-Israel strikes after midterm voting
Trump dropped some Canada tariffs but said he's replacing them with others
Moody's held France's credit rating at Aa3 despite political turmoil and higher yields
US consumer sentiment was revised up to 48.0 even as inflation expectations rose
UK's Healey to give two state-backed lenders a £20 billion capital boost in the budget

corporate.note: Bloom Energy beat estimates by wide margins but shares failed to rally as AI-capex worries weigh
AWS capacity is largely sold out through 2027, CEO says, underscoring tight cloud supply
777 freighter production halted for two months after a supplier dispute, Reuters reports
Creditors are working with restructuring adviser PJT Partners, WSJ reports
Telecom stocks pressured again as Starlink's mobile ambitions advance with cell-tower talks
Moderna's cancer vaccine data raises questions on durability versus Keytruda over the long term
Ukraine partners with Nokia and ICEYE for a Starlink alternative after SpaceX speed limits
Scalpers in Beijing charge hundreds extra for the new foldable iPhone Duo at launch

frontPage.watch: Watch for continued AI-credit jitters across neoclouds and semis ahead of hyperscaler earnings, with oil and yields reacting to Iran and Fed-week risk.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3724 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.855 + 0.974×ln(VIX) + 0.312×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
